name: Azure in Necrosis -Lan Shi zhi Xu Xing Feng Kuang Yan-
original_name: Azure in Necrosis -蓝蚀之墟・腥风狂晏-
source: Death Knights, brave warriors who will die for their masters! A girl who looks like a ghost, vampires and more in this tale of blood and death.
translation: 死亡骑士，是甘愿为主人赴死的勇敢战士！在这个鲜血与死亡交织的故事里，还有幽灵般的少女、吸血鬼，以及更多角色。
